params.name: tenant_slug
params.description: Tenant DNS slug (lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; 3-100 characters).

params.name: start_date
params.description: Inclusive start of the metrics query window (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC, milliseconds optional).

params.name: end_date
params.description: Exclusive end of the metrics query window (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC, milliseconds optional). Events at exactly `end_date` are not included; must be strictly greater than `start_date`.

params.name: aggregation
params.description: Time bucket size for the returned series. Omit to receive raw, non-aggregated data points. When set, the response includes a data point for every interval in `[start_date, end_date)` (half-open: `start_date` inclusive, `end_date` exclusive), filling missing intervals with zero values. Range limits: `minute` requires `end_date - start_date <= 7 days`; `hour` requires `end_date - start_date <= 90 days`; `day`, `week`, `month`, `quarter`, `year` have no explicit limit.

params.name: metric
params.description: Specific metric to return (`timestamp`, `total_events`, `guest_sessions`, `non_guest_sessions`, `unique_sessions`, `unique_ids`, `session_starts`). Omit to receive every metric for each data point.

items.docs: Retrieve tenant activity metrics for a selected date range.
